svg.text: CypherMonkey · Webex Lab · not a vendor document
Virtual Agent–Voice — IVR with a CCAI connector. Dialogflow CX, ES, or bring-your-own.
AI Assistant — Control Hub add-on: summaries, wellness, Auto CSAT, transcription, Real-Time Assist.
AI Agent Studio — Taught in T8-R05 and T8-R03. Re-check the live what's-new page.
WFO Agent Assist — Schedule assistant noted on the agent what's-new page. Not the same SKU as Enterprise WFO.
